title: Context engineering
sub: Assemble one request from fixed parts, cache-friendly order first, and ask once.

steps.h: The question and the conversation so far arrive
steps.d:
"What is the DW-300's Normal cycle water use?"
2 prior turns of history

steps.h: Your code builds the static block: instructions plus every document
steps.d:
12 documents, alphabetical order
same bytes on every call, so a caching
backend can reuse this part unchanged

steps.h: Your code fits the history into what the budget has left
steps.d:
budget 8,000 − 6,934 static = 1,066 left
kept 2 of 2 turns (30 tokens); the oldest
turn would be the first one dropped

steps.h: Your code assembles the final prompt
steps.d:
documents first (unchanged), then history,
then the question last (changes every call)

steps.h: The model answers once, from the full context
steps.d:
"3.2 gallons of water per Normal cycle,
per dw300-manual#4."
